teaser: A boarding pass, gate changed twice, and you reroute around it before the airline finishes the announcement. That's the 8 in you, meeting a delay as a negotiation, and the INTJ in you, holding three alternate plans in reserve. Life path 8 asks for mastery of the material world — money, authority, the machinery that moves people and things. INTJ moves through the world by seeing the structure behind the surface and building a plan to meet it. Crossed, they don't compete for the wheel; they agree on wanting it. What gets tested here isn't ambition. It's whether anyone else gets handed a turn.
excerpt: The smell of someone else's old wool coat, and you price it against the one at full retail down the street — value, not sentiment, pulling you toward the better deal.
